jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety.    

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m. 
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

JOIN THE TEAM THAT’S POWERING PROGRESS 

 

Building cities. Driving commerce. Fueling Progress. For over 100 years, Allison has powered the vehicles and technology that move our world forward.  What powers us? Our employees. From the first person hired by James Allison in 1915 to the thousands across the globe who work for Allison today, we’re driving progress everywhere because we employ top talent worldwide. In both the Allison Transmission and Allison Off-Highway Drive and Motion Systems business units, our team strives to Improve the Way the World Works.   

 

Learn more about this role and how you can begin driving your career forward! 

Primary Purpose of Role: Teamlead Design & Drafting

The Team Lead Design & Drafting leads the Design and Drafting team and is responsible for delivering high-quality engineering design solutions and lifecycle management of drivetrain and gearbox products. The role ensures that product designs meet requirements related to quality, reliability, manufacturability, sustainability and cost efficiency, while supporting the successful execution of new product development projects and engineering changes.

 

Key Responsibilities

·        Lead, coach and develop the Design and Drafting team.

·        Drive employee engagement, performance management and talent development.

·        Ensure high-quality and timely delivery of design activities for new product development projects.

·        Oversee engineering changes, product documentation and bill of material governance.

·        Monitor team workload, resource planning and operational KPIs.

·        Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, quality and project stakeholders.

·        Drive continuous improvement, standardization and automation initiatives.

·        Support design reviews and ensure adherence to engineering standards and processes.

·        Maintain service parts lists and support the complete product lifecycle.

 

Scope Factors

·        Direct leadership of 4 employees in Brugge and indirect coordination of 8 employees in India.

·        Responsibility for engineering activities supporting projects with an annual value of approximately EUR 2 to 3 million.

·        Department budget responsibility of approximately EUR 0.5 million.

·        Oversight of approximately 1,000 design changes annually.

·        Management of approximately 500 service parts list updates per year.

·        Support of 1 to 2 new product development projects annually.

Competencies and Behaviors

·        Strong leadership and coaching capabilities.

·        Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

·        Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.

·        Ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple activities simultaneously.

·        Results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

·        Organized and detail-oriented approach to work.

·        Collaborative team player with a customer-focused mindset.

·        Ability to work independently and make informed decisions.

 

Qualifications and Experience

·        Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent through experience.

·        Minimum 10 years of experience in gearbox design, drivetrain systems or a similar engineering environment.

·        Proven experience with CAD software, preferably PTC Creo.

·        Good understanding of manufacturing, assembly, quality and service operations.

·        Experience working with PLM and workflow systems such as Teamcenter.

·        Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

·        Fluent in English.

·        Good command of Dutch is an advantage; willingness to learn Dutch is required

jobs.occupation: Start as a C Driver and grow into CE
jobs.description:
Job description 
As a C driver at our company, you will start by transporting construction materials and machinery. This is done using different types of trucks, such as box trucks and crane trucks. You will not always be required to load and unload the cargo yourself, but occasionally your assistance may be needed. Do you have experience with a loading crane? That’s a plus! But don’t worry if you don’t, as you will receive internal training. If you already hold a C driving license, you also have the opportunity to progress to CE. This is your chance to further develop your career in the transport sector! What are you waiting for? Join our team and give your career a boost!

 Requirements 
  Start as a C Driver and Grow into CE Have you ever dreamed of hitting the road while taking your career to the next level? Then this is your chance! Start as a C driver and explore the opportunities to grow into a CE driver. Language skills In this role, it is important to have a good command of Dutch, French, and/or English. This not only helps in communication with customers but also broadens your opportunities in an increasingly international environment. Motivation to learn crane work We also offer you the opportunity to learn crane operation. Why let this chance pass you by? These additional skills increase your value on the job market and make you indispensable for future employers. It is not only an investment in your career, but also in your personal development. Why wait? Seize this opportunity to build a successful career as a driver. Now is the perfect time to take the step toward a challenging and rewarding future full of growth and new experiences. Take that first step today!

Do you want to wrap up our team?
 

Tropack is a family business, active as an industrial supplier and service provider. Our core business? Storing and packing goods, parts and spare parts for the non-food sector. This with a big smile, for more than 30 years.
 

As a close team, we offer new employees a warm second home. Short lines of communication and a human approach are key for us.
 

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an quality Inspector Exchange.
 

Location: Oostakker
 

What will be your responsibilities as an inspector?
 
 

• You check and sort used goods. 

• You find out which part it is: type of part, serial number, etc. 

• You perform a visual quality check based on instructions provided. 

• You record the necessary data per part in the computer system. 

• You store the parts in the predefined location after making the right decision. 

• You move goods using a stacker. 

• You report to your team leader. 
 

• You are a motivated employee who likes to roll up your sleeves and don’t mind getting dirty. 

• You enjoy working independently and know how to make proactive adjustments where necessary.  

• Working with a computer? No problem! 

• You can work at a fast pace and attaches great importance to delivering quality.  

• You are available to work full-time in shifts. One week, you will work from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, and the following week from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM. 

• Fluent in English or Dutch.

Adecco is looking for an enthusiastic Customer Support Officer to strengthen the Volvo Action Service team at Volvo Group! 
Help drivers get back on the road quickly and efficiently. As a Breakdown Assistance Call Handler, you are the first point of contact for drivers who experience a breakdown while on the road. You remain calm, ask the right questions, and ensure that every driver receives help as quickly as possible. You coordinate interventions with partner services and keep the driver informed at all times.

This is a role with real impact: thanks to your calm approach, strong communication skills, and solution-oriented mindset, you truly make a difference during stressful situations. Your responsibilities: 

 
• Answer incoming calls from drivers experiencing a breakdown on the road. 
 

 
• Analyze the problem by assessing the situation and gathering the necessary information. 
 

 
• Organize interventions and dispatch them to breakdown services, partners, or internal technicians. 
 

 
• Follow up on cases from A to Z, ensuring clear and continuous communication with the driver. 
 

 
• Register all relevant information in the system (time, location, nature of the problem, planning, etc.). 
 

 
• Remain calm in emergency situations and always act with a strong customer focus. 
 

 
• Work closely with a dedicated team that is available 24/7 to provide optimal customer support. 

What do we expect from you? 

 
• You have strong communication skills and are able to handle phone calls clearly, empathetically, and professionally. 
 

 
• You are stress-resistant and able to maintain an overview in busy and demanding situations. 
 
•  
Problem-solving comes naturally to you. 

 
•  
You are fluent in English and German (minimum B2 level) and another European Language. 

 
• You are comfortable working with digital tools and handling administrative follow-up. 
 
•  
You are willing to work flexible shifts: early, late, day and weekends — truck drivers are on the road anytime, anywhere. 

 
•  
Experience in dispatching, customer service, or roadside/mobility assistance is a plus, but not a requirement. 

 
• You hold a bachelor's degree or have relevant equivalent experience. 
 

 
• You have your own means of transportation.

jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving. 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English, German and at least one other European language. 

 
• Service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

jobs.description:
Help drivers get back on the road quickly and safely.

About the role: As a Telephone Roadside Assistance Agent, you are the first point of contact for drivers who experience a breakdown while on the road. You remain calm, ask the right questions, and make sure every driver receives the support they need. You coordinate interventions with partner services and keep the driver informed throughout the process. It's a role with real impact: thanks to your composure, communication skills, and problem-solving mindset, you make a genuine difference during stressful moments. Your responsibilities: 

 
•  
 Answer incoming calls from drivers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. 

 
• Assess the situation by asking targeted questions and gathering essential information. 
 
•  
Organise interventions and dispatch assistance to towing services, partners, or technicians. 

 
•  
Follow up each case from start to finish, ensuring clear and proactive communication with the driver. 

 
•  
Record all relevant data in the system (time, location, issue details, planning, updates...). 

 
• Stay calm in urgent situations and consistently act with customer focus. 
 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support. 

What we expect from you : 

 
• Strong communication skills and the ability to speak clearly, empathetically, and professionally over the phone. 
 

 
• Stress resilience and the ability to maintain oversight in busy situations. 
 
•  
A natural talent for problem-solving. 

 
•  
Confidence in working with digital tools and administrative follow-up. 

 
• Willingness to work in a shift system: early, late, day, night and weekend work. 
 
• Experience in dispatching, customer service, or roadside assistance is an asset. 
 
•  
Fluent in English, Czech & another Eastern language (minimum B2 level).

Introduction
 

Our truck factory in Ghent is the largest Volvo Group truck factory worldwide. Every day, almost 3000 colleagues assemble top-quality trucks here. Innovation and continuous improvement are standard on our agenda, and that from day 1. We therefore firmly believe in the philosophy of Lean Manufacturing, in which attention to quality, safety and the environment are our top priority. Our site today has many different departments, but we all have one thing in common: passion for what we do. 
 

Meet your team
 

You will join a team of engineers who work both independently and in a team. Together we support each other to give the customer a qualitative and feasible solution to meet the desired truck specifications.
 

Your ideal job?
 

On our assembly line and in the Market Adaptation Center, all requests for a customized truck are handled according to the following principle: Our customer? He is king. Do you have good technical insight and would you like to take on the challenge with us to support the customer in the design of the ideal truck?
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• Investigate and answer customer questions about technical concepts that are not offered as a standard. This in terms of technical feasibility, cost price, lead time & legal compliance.  

• Advising other departments on technical product solutions to adapt standard trucks to customer demand. In doing so, you make decisions independently and take final responsibility for these concepts. 

• You ensure optimal coordination and cooperation between various parties involved (design, order planning, suppliers, sales engineers) so that the production of the designs is ensured efficiently and on time. 

• Continuously polish your technical knowledge & keep your product knowledge up-to-date 

Who are you?
 
 

• Minimum bachelor's degree, preferably in a technical field. Additional knowledge in economics can be an added value. Technical knowledge related to vehicles and/or knowledge of the automotive industry is an advantage. 

• Being able to work in a team is a must. You easily make contacts and maintain good relationships with others. 

• Be administrative, organizational, and commercially skilled. 

• Have excellent networking skills. 

• Good knowledge of MS Office. 

• Good knowledge of English is a requirement (other languages are an advantage).

Shipment & Export
